title: formatNumber
description: Formats a numeric value with fixed decimal precision and strips trailing zeros. Accepts the sentinel string 'mixed' for multi-selection UI.

params.name: num
params.description: Value to format. Pass 'mixed' or 'Mixed' to return the Mixed label; null/NaN yields an empty string.

params.name: precision
params.description: Number of decimal places used by toFixed before trailing zeros are removed.

returns.description: Formatted number string, 'Mixed', or empty string.
